subject: F-V01-08-TOKEN-API-CLIENTS
supported_current_properties: raw bearer secret not persisted by credential core
credential hash/id/scopes separated from self.root identity
revocation/expiry/scope fail closed in primitive token core
token ingress authenticates before exposing BUSY state
all admitted token interactions route through FrankExecutionGate
network HTTP/TLS server is not yet implemented in this evidence
durable execution identity is explicitly not yet bound in V15

material_gap.finding: FrankTokenIngressCore validates and echoes request_id but does not use it to resolve an existing active or terminal execution. Each successful admission creates a fresh random execution_id; exact same logical transport replay while the first execution is active therefore falls through to physical BUSY instead of idempotent same execution/result.
material_gap.owner_fixed_requirement: same authenticated credential + same session + same request_id -> idempotent_same_lease_or_same_result

required_next_test: require same stable execution/lease identity without second physical execution
send C/S/R2 while active and require FRANK_BUSY
release to terminal then retry C/S/R and require deterministic terminal replay rather than a second task execution
authority_boundary: Transport idempotency may identify/replay execution receipts but must not mint truth, state-write, or effect authority; effect idempotency and current lease-epoch fencing remain separate deterministic gates.
